name: facet
description: Facet's agent builds, evaluates, serves and maintains a small model for one repeated task.

interface.shortDescription: The autonomous model factory: builds, evaluates, serves and maintains a model for one task
interface.longDescription: Describe a narrow, repeated task and Facet's agent builds a small model for it on its own, runs plain-language evals on every change, serves it through an OpenAI-compatible API, and keeps it right as you flag misses. You approve each quote before anything runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a Facet Model for this classification step and show me what it would cost to make it better
